source9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_33/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# Union all dimension tables with same schema (source4, source5, source7, source9)
dim_union = pd.concat([source4, source5, source7, source9], ignore_index=True)

# Join all aspect tables on ROW_WID with source8 (which has INTERACTIONS_NUM)
# Start with source8 as base
df = source8

# Join with source0 (VISITS_NUM)

# Join with source6 (INBOUND_CALLS_NUM)
df = df.merge(source6, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join with source1 (COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM)
df = df.merge(source1, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join with source2 (TECHSUPPORT_NUM)
df = df.merge(source2, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join with source3 (KEYWORDS_NUM)
df = df.merge(source3, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join with the unioned dimension table on ROW_WID
df = df.merge(dim_union, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# The target schema is only ['INTERACTIONS_NUM'], so project only that column
# No group by needed because target has no keys and only one column
